changes: Renamed Portrait Studio to IDFrame in the application, changelog, and update messages.
Existing installed shortcuts are renamed to IDFrame when the destination name is unused, retaining the camera icon and compatible update paths.
Project source is now maintained on GitHub. LAN OTA publication remains controlled by the host.
Saving now asks for the person's name and generates PersonName_2x2.png, using underscores for spaces.
Duplicate filenames receive numbered suffixes such as _002 and _003. Existing photos are preserved, including when another save creates the same filename at the same time.
The name prompt shows the generated filename, validates Windows filename characters, and clears the person's name when a new photo is opened or pasted.
The host can follow its active LAN IPv4 address automatically when starting the server or preparing a release, and checks for changes every three seconds while the server runs.
The host's own registered application follows that same LAN IP instead of localhost. Remote client addresses are not rewritten.
Updated the host firewall setup script to retain local-subnet access when the host IP changes.
Added Auto as the default removal mode. It compares both local model results for missing person interiors and background spill, then selects one complete result.
Shows whether Auto selected Protect person or Fine hair. Both manual modes remain available if you prefer the other result.
Auto can take longer because it evaluates both models. Selection is a heuristic and can still make mistakes; an available result is retained if one model cannot detect a person.
Added Protect person as the default removal mode after testing the original client portraits with missing hair and scalp areas.
Kept Fine hair as a selectable mode for detailed curls. Switching modes after processing recomputes the result and resets its crop.
Replaced the experimental two-model blend with separate modes to avoid adding patches or damaging the head outline. Both modes remain offline.
Prepared an experimental two-model protection pass against the client screen-photo examples.
Testing the original portraits exposed artifacts; this approach was replaced by the selectable modes in v1.1.8.
Added an interactive 2 × 2 crop preview with a zoom slider, mouse-wheel zoom, and drag-to-position controls.
Reset restores the full photo framing. Opening or pasting a new photo clears the previous crop.
Saved photos use the selected framing, rendered from the full-resolution cutout, with a white background at 1200 × 1200 pixels and 600 DPI.
Added a Changelog button beside the application heading.
Browse release notes by version, with your installed version selected automatically. Notes are available offline.
Added a centered Checking Updates dialog with the camera logo and download progress, without a console window.
Existing clients can receive launcher improvements through OTA. The refreshed launcher takes effect after closing and reopening the updated app.

Adapted the portrait model using the camo and low-quality photo folders, retaining earlier curl examples. Some missing faces and clothing are better preserved; severe camouflage and blurry boundaries remain imperfect.
Added a locally adapted MODNet portrait matting model for finer hair and curls.
Preserved continuous hair opacity and used higher-resolution, proportionally resized model inputs.
Kept the original U2Net model as a fallback when the matting model is absent.
Changed exports to 2 × 2 inches: 1200 × 1200 pixels at 600 DPI, with a solid white background.
Fit portraits proportionally into the square while preserving original files.
Prepared Philippine passport photo dimensions of 35 × 45 mm at 600 DPI; later replaced by the 2 × 2 inch format in v1.1.2.
Displayed the client version in the application title and heading, with automatic version increments for changed releases.
Included camera-logo branding and refresh support for desktop, Start menu, and existing taskbar shortcuts.
Included clipboard photo pasting with Ctrl+V alongside Open photo.
Included 600 DPI export with the earlier 208 × 208 pixel dimensions.
Updated the default LAN update port to 8766 and provided an installer upgrade for version 1 clients.
Initial offline Python portrait background remover with white-background PNG exports.
Added a Windows installer, desktop shortcut, and startup checks for LAN updates.
Downloaded only changed application files while retaining unchanged files.
